Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About Gartner IT:**

Join a world\-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting\-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome\-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.


**About the role:**

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our team, with a primary focus on database architecture, optimization, and management. The ideal candidate will have at least 4\+ years of robust, hands\-on experience in PostgreSQL (preferably AWS RDS), advanced SQL, and database development, as well as deep expertise in designing and managing ETL data pipelines. Experience with both batch and event\-driven data processing is essential. Strong Python skills for data engineering, and familiarity with AWS Glue, AWS Batch, AWS S3, CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Git), and AI\-related technologies are also required.


**What you will do:**

* Architect, develop, and maintain robust database structures (tables, views, procedures, functions, packages) with a focus on PostgreSQL (AWS RDS).
* Optimize database performance, write and debug complex SQL queries, and ensure reliability and scalability of the database layer.
* Design, build, and manage ETL pipelines using Python and AWS Glue/Batch, integrating with AWS S3 for data storage and retrieval.
* Develop and maintain procedures, packages, and scripts for data migration and processing large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
* Implement both batch and event\-driven data processing architectures.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver secure, high\-quality data solutions that meet business requirements.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automate deployments with Jenkins, and manage code repositories using Git.
* Support AI and machine learning initiatives by preparing, processing, and managing data for model training and inference.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data engineering and database issues as they arise.

**What you will need** :


Strong IT professional with 4\-6 yrs of experience in software development for data engineering using Python, AWS. The candidate should have strong problem\-solving skills along with high on ownership and accountability.


**Must have:**

* 4\+ years of robust, hands\-on experience in data engineering, with a strong focus on PostgreSQL (AWS RDS).
* Proven expertise in architecting, optimizing, and maintaining complex database solutions using PostgreSQL.
* Extensive experience developing and maintaining database objects (tables, views, procedures, functions, packages).
* Deep proficiency in designing and managing ETL data pipelines, leveraging Python and AWS Glue/Batch.
* Demonstrated experience with both batch and event\-driven data processing architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS S3 for data storage and integration.
* Experience with data migration and processing of large datasets (structured and unstructured).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins, and Git for automated deployments and version control.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Experience with AI and machine learning libraries and frameworks is a plus.

**Who you are:**

* Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related field required
* Excellent communication and prioritization skills.
* Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast\-paced AGILE\-SCRUM environment.
* Owns success – Takes responsibility for successful delivery of the solutions.
* Strong desire to improve upon their skills in software development, frameworks, and

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.


**Who are we?**

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.


Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.


Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.


**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.


We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.


Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.


We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.


**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.


It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.


**What do we offer?**

Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.


In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.


Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Engineer - Data Centre
description:
**Grow with us**
----------------


**About this opportunity:**

  

Join Ericsson as an Engineer – Data Centre, an integral role where you will have the opportunity to manage, maintain, and deployment of the physical infrastructure within the data centre. This role involves both building and operational support activities to ensure optimal data centre performance and reliability. The engineer will be actively involved in activities such as rack installation, cable laying, network device installation, cable dressing, and material handling. In addition, the role includes troubleshooting hardware and connectivity issues, coordinating with customers and OEM vendors, and ensuring all incidents are resolved within defined SLA timelines.

 **What you will do:**

* Help the installation of data centre devices (Arista, Juniper, Cisco, Ciena, Nokia) and infrastructure by guiding the field team to fully understand the entire scope.
* Address technical queries and provide solutions to ensure smooth execution of field work.
* Collaborate with the customer to identify and resolve any discrepancies in the detailed document aligned with the scope of work.
* Prepare the Bill of Materials for consumable items based on the project's requirements.
* Contribute to POC and document drafting related to the process methodology.
* Ensure field technicians receive ongoing skill development through new training programs.
* Stay current with the latest technologies and best practices in the data centre industry.
* Involvement in the upcoming decommissioning efforts, in tendum with the build team, will include dismantling equipment, acquire packaging materials, and handle the entire process through customer portals.
* Work in collaboration with the project manager on upcoming projects and submit technical quotations based on the customer\-defined scope of work for invoicing.

 **The skills you bring:**

* Total years of experience \- 2 to 5 years
* Proven experience in installation, commissioning, and decommissioning of hardware within data centre environments.
* Proven experience in remote troubleshooting and ability to operate effectively in a data centre environment.
* Strong technical expertise in data centre operations and IT infrastructure, including servers, switches, routers, cabling systems, and fibre optics.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and maintain physical infrastructure within a data centre environment.
* Strong hands\-on experience and in\-depth understanding of Cisco, Ciena, Juniper, and Arista network devices and technologies.
* Strong expertise in optical, copper, and fibre cabling systems, including fibre standards, connector types, and cable management practices.
* Flexible and adaptable, capable of working both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* Skilled in reviewing, enhancing, and maintaining Methods of Procedure (MOPs) and operational guidelines.
* Strong focus on service excellence with a customer\-first mindset, leveraging multi\-domain technical competence.
* Adheres strictly to approved MOPs, safety protocols, and operational instructions without deviation.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across teams and with customers.
* A proactive team player with strong interpersonal skills, able to work seamlessly with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficient in spoken and written English to support effective communication in global environments.
 **Why join Ericsson?**At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
